description: A test script for Git push.default settings, including setup of repositories, testing various push behaviors, and workflow scenarios.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Checks that the last commit in local and remote repositories are identical.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Tests that a push with specified push.default value succeeds and the remote is updated accordingly.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Tests that a push with specified push.default value fails and no remote updates occur.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Tests push behavior under different workflows and push.default settings, including success and failure scenarios.
